method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation incorporating amendments up to the Statutes (Minor Amendments) Act 2017 s 10 (in operation 13 September 2017); last reprint listed Reprint 2 as at 22 February 2013; legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc_49104, retrieved 7 September 2026. No regulation deposited: the s 7(1)(eb) prescribed amount (s 21B) is an input.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 4(1), (4), (4a), 6(1)-(5), (7), (8), 7A(1), 7(1)(a)-(e), (2A), (2), (3), 14(2), 19, 20(4), (5), 21B (input); out: transitional provisions, Trustees Act s 65 orders (ss 8, 9), urgent distributions (s 11), s 12(2), class funds (s 13), form, costs, rescission, increase and commutation of orders (ss 14(1), (3)-(7), 15-17), replacing an administrator (s 18), the administrator's protection (s 20(1)-(3)), evidence (s 21A), rules of court
seat: the family member left out of a will or the intestacy (spouse, de facto partner, former spouse maintained by the deceased, child, grandchild, stepchild or parent) asking whether they may claim provision out of the estate
